## About
Patrick's Roofing is a local, family owned company roofing homes and businesses across the greater Dallas-Fort Worth area. We have families ourselves, so we understand what your roof is protecting.
When you hire us, you get the owner on your job. Patrick Malpass is personally involved on every project, from the initial inspection to the final walk-through. We believe in being present, communicating clearly and paying attention to the details.
We are an Accredited Business with the Better Business Bureau of Fort Worth and a Certified CertainTeed Shingle Master Company. Our neighbors rate us 4.9 from 132 Google reviews.

## Services
- New roof: A new roof for your home, with Patrick keeping you informed from start to finish.
- Tear off and new decking: We remove the old roof and replace damaged wood before the new roof goes on.
- Composition shingles: Options include Class 4 impact resistant shingles, Landmark Designer shingles and CT 20 3-tab shingles.
- Flat roof replacement: Replacement of flat roof sections on homes and businesses.
- Seamless gutters: Seamless gutters as part of your roofing project or on their own.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free roof inspections?
A: Yes. Give us a call to schedule your free roof inspection.

Q: Can you help with a hail damage insurance claim?
A: We help you understand the often complex process of dealing with hail damage insurance claims.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: All of Fort Worth, plus Roanoke, Lantana, Keller, North Richland Hills, Hurst, Euless, Bedford, Colleyville, Southlake and surrounding cities.
